firstPlayerRule: Randomly choose the starting player and give them the Start Player Marker. They reveal their Paladin and choose a Tavern card first, then take the first action; play proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The initial Townsfolk recruitment during setup runs in reverse turn order, starting to the right of the chosen first player.
Ignore the marker-passing step in the first round. In later rounds, pass the Start Player Marker clockwise.
